title: DashboardModuleConfig
description: Configuration for a Dashboards module — a KPI strip + filter pills + widget grid. Rendered by the DashboardGrid template. Every node carries a stable `id`.

kpiStrip.description: Top KPI strip — small big-number cards.

format.description: Number presentation applied via Intl.NumberFormat in the document locale. Recognised: 'integer', 'decimal' / 'decimal:<n>', 'percent', 'currency-<ISO>' (e.g. 'currency-AED'). Anything else leaves the value verbatim.

unit.description: Unit suffix beside the value, e.g. 'hrs', 'L'.

valueSuffix.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. 'until critical at current consumption'.

badge.description: Trailing chip on the label row, e.g. 'Real Time'.

tone.description: Semantic/accent tone. In a 'stat' strip it tints the icon disc (lavender/yellow/dark fall back to neutral there); in an 'accent' strip it drives the tile's top accent bar and icon chip in full.

kpiStripVariant.description: How the KPI strip renders. 'stat' (default) is the KpiTile row (icon disc on the left). 'accent' is the StatTile row — a coloured top accent bar per tile, the label uppercased with the icon chip on the inline-end, and the tile's valueSuffix as the caption.

filterPills.description: Filter-pill bar (Time / Driver / Vehicle / Group By).

options.description: Explicit option list for a single-/multi-select or group-by pill. A dashboard module has no entity data adapter of its own, so options are authored here rather than derived from `entityId`.

dimension.description: The data dimension this pill drives. Defaults to the pill's own `id`. A pill whose dimension no datum on the page carries is not rendered at all (verdict V11 — a control that cannot change anything must be absent, never inert).

allLabel.description: Label of the UNSCOPED option the renderer injects at the head of every collection pill (single-select / group-by). Default 'All <label>'. Never author an 'all' option in `options` — a value no datum carries would filter everything away.

widgetGrid.description: Main 2-column widget grid — gauges, charts, lists.

views.description: Saved-view declarations. Each dashboard tab is itself a saved view.

children.description: type:'stack' ONLY — the widgets stacked vertically inside this one grid cell, in order. A stack is a LAYOUT node: no dataSource of its own, its span is the cell it occupies, its children are full width of the stack and keep their own dataSource.height. Nesting a stack inside a stack is rejected.

DashboardDataSource.description: The shared dashboard data-binding vocabulary (one shape across every widget type). `kind: 'static'` authors the values inline; `kind: 'module'` derives them from a licensed module at boot. Extra keys are allowed so authoring stays permissive.

colorToken.description: Non-categorical colour binding for this series — a token reference such as "var(--color-primary)", resolved at paint time so it follows the active theme/tenant. Wins over colorIndex.

dimensions.description: Dimension values this datum belongs to, keyed by dimension name (a filter pill's `dimension`, defaulting to its `id`). Each value is one id or an array of ids. Omitting a dimension means 'not scoped by it' — the datum survives every selection of that pill.

media.description: Leading visual of the row's entity block. src/initials render an Avatar; a bare icon renders a tinted IconBadge. src > initials > icon.

icon.description: Named lucide icon, kebab-case, drawn before every cell of this column — the entity glyph a code-shaped column carries. Decorative; the cell text is the accessible content.

tone.description: Fill tone of a render:'bar' cell when no thresholds band matches.

thresholds.description: Threshold bands for a render:'bar' cell — the highest band whose `from` the value clears wins.

counters.description: Per-counter key for a render:'counters' cell — one entry per position in the cell's number[].

colorToken.description: Non-categorical colour binding for this counter — a token reference such as "var(--color-primary)", resolved at paint time so it follows the active theme/tenant. Wins over colorIndex.

colorToken.description: Non-categorical colour binding for this legend entry — a token reference such as "var(--color-primary)", resolved at paint time so it follows the active theme/tenant. Wins over colorIndex.

min.description: Pinned lower bound of a VALUE axis. Zero-base both scales of a dual-axis chart rather than letting two independent fits invent a correlation (verdict V4).

max.description: Pinned upper bound of a VALUE axis.

groups.description: heatmap-calendar x-axis outer tier: group labels drawn under the column labels, each centred on its own run of `span` columns. Only read on axis.x.

tickLabels.description: heatmap-calendar column-axis display labels, parallel to `categories`. `categories` are identifiers (cells[].x matches them) so they must stay unique; a two-tier axis wants repeated ticks. Only read on axis.x.

center.description: geospatial-heatmap opening camera centre, [longitude, latitude]. Omit to fit the camera to items[].position.

zoom.description: geospatial-heatmap opening zoom. Omit to fit it to items[].position.

legendOrientation.description: donut legend placement: 'horizontal' (default, in the card legend row) or 'vertical' (beside the chart).

note.description: stat-tile-group ONLY — a formula/definition note shown at the inline-end of the panel header, e.g. "Available = Total − Reported − Weekly off − Vacation".

tiles.description: stat-tile-group tiles — accent-topped stat cards (label / value / caption / tone / optional icon).

target.description: Denominator drawn after the value as /target (270/292).

trend.description: Same-row delta at the inline-end (+12 vs Yest.). Ignored when target is set.

icon.description: Named lucide icon, kebab-case. Omit for the icon-less tile.

dimensions.description: Dimension values this tile belongs to (see a slice's dimensions).

tone.description: breakdown-strip ONLY — semantic status tone of the slice's segment and headline value. Default 'neutral'.

display.description: breakdown-strip ONLY — pre-formatted display of value (e.g. "03"). Falls back to the number.

colorToken.description: Non-categorical colour binding for this slice — a token reference such as "var(--color-primary)", resolved at paint time so it follows the active theme/tenant. Wins over colorIndex.

dimensions.description: Dimension values this datum belongs to, keyed by dimension name (a filter pill's `dimension`, defaulting to its `id`). Each value is one id or an array of ids. Omitting a dimension means 'not scoped by it' — the datum survives every selection of that pill.

legendPlacement.description: bar / stacked-bar / line legend placement relative to the plot. Default 'bottom'. Distinct from legendOrientation, which is the donut's beside-vs-above knob.

entityLabel.description: Header of a leaderboard's entity column. Default 'Name' — author the noun the board ranks.

showRank.description: Renders the leaderboard's leading RANK column. Set false for a board whose design carries no rank column; the podium keeps its medallion either way.

categoryDimensions.description: Dimension values of each x/y CATEGORY, parallel to `categories`. A category axis is the one filterable collection whose members are bare strings with nowhere to carry their own `dimensions`; this array does it positionally. Dropping a category drops that index from `categories`, from `axis.x.tickLabels` and from every series' `data[]` in step.

items.description: Dimension values this datum belongs to, keyed by dimension name (a filter pill's `dimension`, defaulting to its `id`). Each value is one id or an array of ids. Omitting a dimension means 'not scoped by it' — the datum survives every selection of that pill.

variants.description: Whole-source overrides per filter combination — the scalar counterpart of per-datum `dimensions`, for a widget whose datum IS the widget (a gauge, a KPI card, a donut centre). The FIRST variant whose `when` matches every active pill value is shallow-merged over this source, before per-datum filtering runs.

when.description: Dimension values this datum belongs to, keyed by dimension name (a filter pill's `dimension`, defaulting to its `id`). Each value is one id or an array of ids. Omitting a dimension means 'not scoped by it' — the datum survives every selection of that pill.
